name: @ophis/plugin-elizaos
description: elizaOS plugin for same-chain Ophis ERC-20 swaps signed by the agent wallet, with optional referral attribution.

EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.description: 0x hex private key (EOA) the agent signs orders with. Keep it funded with the sell token + a little native gas for the one-time approval.

OPHIS_REFERRAL_CODE.description: Optional Ophis referral code for attribution on indexed chains. Register at https://swap.ophis.fi/#/affiliate; rewards depend on the active campaign.

OPHIS_FEE_CHAIN.description: OPTIONAL default chain for requests that don't name one (e.g. base, unichain, arbitrum). If UNSET, a swap request MUST name its chain — the plugin never silently picks one. No default is provided on purpose.
